1.Load in the data set (File 1) and check the data (use the View() function to see the full data set).
Assess the data type for each variable and perform any necessary preliminary data cleaning. Generate a histogram of the distribution of each variable and check missingness.
```{r}
dirty_file1 <- read.csv("/Users/kellygolden/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-DartmouthCollege/HSE 103/Classwork/Week 6/HSE103_DataWorkshop_File1.csv")

unclean_file2 <- read.csv("/Users/kellygolden/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-DartmouthCollege/HSE 103/Classwork/Week 6/HSE103_DataWorkshop_File2.csv")

View(dirty_file1)
head(dirty_file1)
```


```{r}

#changed all to integers from characters
dirty_file1$C2 <- as.integer(dirty_file1$C2)
dirty_file1$C3 <- as.integer(sub("^X_", "",dirty_file1$C3)) #removed missing X_
dirty_file1$C6 <- as.integer(sub(-99.000, "NA",dirty_file1$C6))#sub missing values of -99 as "NA"
dirty_file1$C5 <- as.integer(sub(-99.000, "NA",dirty_file1$C5))#sub missing values of -99 as "NA"
dirty_file1$C1 <- as.integer(dirty_file1$C1)
dirty_file1$C4 <- as.integer(dirty_file1$C4)
dirty_file1$C8 <- as.integer(dirty_file1$C8)
dirty_file1$C7 <- as.integer(dirty_file1$C7)


glimpse(dirty_file1)
  
hist(dirty_file1$x)
hist(dirty_file1$C2)
hist(dirty_file1$C3)
hist(dirty_file1$C6)
hist(dirty_file1$C5)
hist(dirty_file1$C1)
hist(dirty_file1$C4)
hist(dirty_file1$C8)
hist(dirty_file1$C7)
```
